empirical_finding: Candidate-coded AI descriptions contained visual wording in 27/28 items versus 4,321/24,842 BLV questions
plausible_consequence: A visual-first description may supply detail not implied by the immediate question
design_implication: Allow user-selectable detail and begin with requested task information
causal_limit: No evidence of user harm or cognitive change

empirical_finding: Candidate-coded AI descriptions contained uncertainty wording in 22/28 items versus 126/24,842 BLV questions
plausible_consequence: Uncertainty language can support calibration, but its usefulness cannot be inferred from frequency alone
design_implication: Separate observed evidence, inference, and uncertainty in descriptions
causal_limit: No measure of trust, behavior, or safety outcome

empirical_finding: Candidate-coded task relevance was 14/28 AI descriptions versus 22,415/24,842 BLV questions
plausible_consequence: Descriptions may not match a specific request when prompt context is absent
design_implication: Evaluate outputs against explicit user goal where available
